name: Machine Tricep Dip
description: The machine tricep dip is performed on a dedicated seated dip machine with pads that the hands push down against. Because the machine guides the movement and provides back support, it eliminates stabilization demands and allows the lifter to focus entirely on tricep loading. The seated position removes body weight from the equation, allowing very precise loading through the full extension movement. It is accessible for beginners and allows easy progression.

execution.starting_position: Sit in the machine with the back against the pad. Grasp the handles and begin with elbows slightly bent.
execution.setup_instructions: Adjust the seat height so the starting position has the elbows at approximately 90 degrees.
steps: Step 1: Begin with elbows at 90 degrees, gripping the handles.
Step 2: Push the handles downward by extending the elbows.
Step 3: Extend to full lockout, squeezing the triceps.
Step 4: Return under control to the starting position.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale on the press down, inhale on the return.
common_mistakes: Not reaching full extension at the bottom
Leaning forward off the back pad
safety_considerations: Machine design varies — check the specific ROM before loading
